properties.name: An idea that came from reading waits for a real use before it is built (advisory)
properties.statement:
An idea whose only source is reading (an article, a paper, a standard, another project's documentation), with no person or project that met the need in use, stays a recorded idea and is not built until a real use asks for it: a field report, a person's friction, or a measured failure. It is a triage rule, not a gate. Some reading-sourced ideas do pay off, and the knowledge-graph requirements kept on 2026-10-13 came from research. So a person may still choose to build one; the rule only says the default is to wait.

WHY, measured by the 2026-10-13 judgement pass of reflow2's own design: ideas from field reports (dev_storyflow, Alex, flo2, bhome) were mostly built, and ideas from reading (knot theory, game theory, PEP sections, OpenMBEE, LangSmith, CAP/PACELC) mostly were not, and were proposed for rejection. Adopted on @ajs's word, 2026-10-13 ("Go with your recommendations"), with the proposed rejections of reading-only ideas accepted in the same ruling. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
